rules.rule: Read AGENTS.md, then RULES.md, then catalog.json, then the component doc for the piece you change.
rules.why: An agent that skips this order invents a piece that is not in the system.

rules.rule: The repo is the source of truth. Figma mirrors it.
rules.why: Two sources that both lead will drift.

rules.rule: Components use semantic tokens such as color.action.primary.
rules.why: A theme can restyle every screen without a component edit.

rules.rule: Do not rename a role in tokens/schema.json.
rules.why: Every reader keys off those names.

rules.rule: A theme supplies values only. It cannot replace a component.
rules.why: A brand fills the kit. It does not fork the kit.
A brand fills the steps. It does not add a step.

rules.rule: Status hues stay success, warning, error, and info.
rules.why: A brand may change the color. It may not change the meaning.
One target size keeps controls easy to hit.

rules.rule: Harbor is a test theme, not a brand.
rules.why: It exists to prove a second accent restyles the system.

rules.rule: Every component has a purpose, props, when to use, and when not to use.

rules.why: A screen with two primary buttons hides the main action.

rules.rule: Chunk a screen into small groups.
rules.why: A person can hold only a few choices at once.

rules.rule: Prefer a documented prop over a new component.
rules.why: Fewer pieces stay easier to use correctly.

rules.rule: Icons go through icons/. Lucide is the default set.
rules.why: The icon set can be swapped without rewriting components.

rules.rule: Run build:tokens and build:catalog, and commit both outputs.
rules.why: People and agents then read the same values.

rules.rule: Do not hand-edit catalog.json or AGENTS.md.
rules.why: Both files are generated. A hand edit will fail the check.

rules.rule: Schema, audit, and layer-sync checks block.
rules.why: A broken theme, a raw color, or a stale catalog should not merge.

rules.rule: The first live surface is web, and the first export is CSS variables.
rules.why: Social, thumbnail, video, and Tailwind wait until this base is the source.

rules.rule: A new product piece needs an adopt, candidate, or leave-out decision.
rules.why: Nothing undecided ships. A candidate joins the kit on its second use. A product-only piece stays out.
